violations.rule_name: No PHI in logs or console output
violations.explanation: Prints a whole patient object to console output, which may expose identifiers.

remediation.suggestion: Log a non-sensitive event or pseudonymous record identifier instead of PHI.
agent_steps: Remove direct identifiers, clinical values, and whole sensitive objects from the log or print call.
Preserve operational context with an event ID or pseudonymous record ID.
Keep logging structure and severity unchanged unless required by the fix.

violations.rule_name: No personal or special-category data in logs

Retain only the minimum operational metadata needed to debug the event.
